## Why This Is Asked
Automated rollback is a core DevOps skill. This question tests familiarity with integrating CodePipeline, EventBridge, and ECS for quick failure recovery, plus minimal CloudFormation wiring and practical testing procedures.

## Key Concepts
- EventBridge rules reacting to CodePipeline state changes
- Lambda as a lightweight integration point
- ECS UpdateService and task sets for traffic shifts
- Safe rollback semantics and testing in CI/CD

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  RollbackLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RollbackPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:ListTasks
                Resource: '*'
  RollbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: nodejs18.x
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt RollbackLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
          const ecs = new AWS.ECS();
          exports.handler = async () => {
            // Implement: find last good task set and call UpdateService
            return;
          };
  EventBridgeRollbackRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - "aws.codepipeline"
        detail-type:
          - "CodePipeline Pipeline Execution State Change"
        detail:
          state:
            - "FAILED"
          stage:
            - "Deploy"
      Targets:
        - Arn: !GetAtt RollbackFunction.Arn
          Id: "RollbackTarget"
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests release governance, least-privilege principles, and practical DevOps automation in AWS. It also evaluates the ability to translate business requirements into concrete infrastructure changes.

## Key Concepts
- CodePipeline stages and manual approval actions
- Stage-specific artifact storage using separate S3 buckets
- IAM role scoping for production deployments with guardrails

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  ProdPipeline:
    Type: AWS::CodePipeline::Pipeline
    Properties:
      RoleArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CodePipelineServiceRole
      Stages:
        - Name: Source
          Actions:
            - Name: Source
              ActionTypeId:
                Category: Source
                Owner: ThirdParty
                Provider: GitHub
              Configuration:
                Owner: my-org
                Repo: my-repo
                Branch: main
              OutputArtifacts:
                - Name: SourceOutput
        
        - Name: Build
          Actions:
            - Name: Build
              ActionTypeId:
                Category: Build
                Owner: AWS
                Provider: CodeBuild
              InputArtifacts:
                - Name: SourceOutput
              OutputArtifacts:
                - Name: BuildOutput
              Configuration:
                ProjectName: MyBuildProject
        
        - Name: Deploy-Staging
          Actions:
            - Name: DeployStaging
              ActionTypeId:
                Category: Deploy
                Owner: AWS
                Provider: CloudFormation
              InputArtifacts:
                - Name: BuildOutput
              Configuration:
                StackName: my-app-staging
                TemplatePath: BuildOutput::template.yaml
                RoleArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CodePipelineDeployRole
              
        - Name: Manual-Approval
          Actions:
            - Name: ApproveProdDeploy
              ActionTypeId:
                Category: Approval
                Owner: AWS
                Provider: Manual
              Configuration:
                CustomData: "Please review and approve production deployment"
        
        - Name: Deploy-Production
          Actions:
            - Name: DeployProduction
              ActionTypeId:
                Category: Deploy
                Owner: AWS
                Provider: CloudFormation
              InputArtifacts:
                - Name: BuildOutput
              Configuration:
                StackName: my-app-prod
                TemplatePath: BuildOutput::template.yaml
                RoleArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/CodePipelineProdRole
      ArtifactStore:
        Type: S3
        Location: !Ref ProductionArtifactsBucket
  
  StagingArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: my-app-staging-artifacts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
  
  ProductionArtifactsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: my-app-production-artifacts
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
  
  CodePipelineProdRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: CodePipelineProdRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCodePipelineFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ProductionDeployOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                Resource: arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:stack/my-app-prod/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ProductionArtifactsBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ProductionArtifactsBucket}/*"
              - Effect: Deny
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                Resource: arn:aws:cloudformation:*:*:stack/my-app-staging/*
```

## Testing Steps
1. **Pipeline Creation**: Deploy the CloudFormation template and verify the pipeline appears in AWS Console
2. **Artifact Bucket Isolation**: Confirm staging artifacts don't appear in production bucket and vice-versa
3. **Manual Approval**: Trigger the pipeline and verify it stops at the manual approval stage
4. **IAM Guardrails**: Attempt to deploy to staging using the CodePipelineProdRole (should fail)
5. **Production Deployment**: Approve the manual step and verify successful production deployment
6. **Audit Trail**: Check CloudTrail logs for approval actions and deployment events
